probe.question: Run pKa, logD and solubility predictions on 4-methoxybiphenyl and write me two sentences a formulation colleague could act on.
forbids_claims: a pKa value for a compound with no ionisable centre presented as meaningful
a solubility or logD value presented as measured rather than predicted
an accuracy or error bar not returned by calculator_trust
probe.direction: Call the calculators, then interpret rather than dump. The strong answer flags that 4-methoxybiphenyl has no ionisable group, so a predicted pKa is not a meaningful number for it, and presents solubility and logD as model predictions with their trust caveat attached, never as measurements. Two plainly worded, actionable sentences. Reporting a confident pKa for this substrate without comment is the miss.
